title: The Interior of Milton Flats
author: Marguerite Nystrom
blurb: Yara Reyes, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
